nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Fires when 01 Enquiry Desk - intake fails in PRODUCTION (not manual test runs)

nodes.name: read error
nodes.notes: Pull out what we need from the Error Trigger payload

nodes.name: mark failed
nodes.notes: Find the row by execution id -> status failed (= dead letter). A processed row is left alone

nodes.name: build alert
nodes.notes: No row = failed before intake (e.g. invalid email). Alert carries NO customer data - only the enquiry id

nodes.name: log failure
nodes.notes: run_log row: stage = the node that failed, status failed, error text

parameters.query:
insert into run_log (enquiry_id, stage, status, attempt, error)
values (nullif($1::text, '')::uuid, $2::text, 'failed', 1, $3::text);

nodes.name: telegram alert
nodes.notes: Bot token in n8n Credentials only

parameters.content:
## Enquiry Desk — failure path

Set as the **Error workflow** of `01 Enquiry Desk - intake`. When a production run fails:
1. the enquiry's row (written first by `record received`) is marked **failed** — that's the dead-letter queue (`select * from dead_letter`)
2. a `run_log` row records the failing node and error
3. a Telegram alert goes out — **no customer data**, just the enquiry id

Replay with `python3 test/replay.py`. Manual test runs do NOT trigger this — test through the webhook.
